_readme: Best fit of the physical Tom to a tom recording of unknown provenance, from cmd/fit-physical. NOT a validated acoustic calibration and NOT the shipped default: it misses all three adoption-gate terms (partial frequency 56.9 cents against 25, partial decay 0.581 against 0.25, spectral envelope 12.3 dB against 4). Re-derived 2026-07-31 on the right channel and the corrected partial measurement; every earlier fit in the docs was measured differently and is not comparable. See docs/physical-measured-fit.md. Nothing in the test suite depends on the recording, which is gitignored.
